scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('cargo build --target wasm32v1-none --release --workspace', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (e) { console.log('Rust/wasm32v1-none build skipped'); }"
scripts.test: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('cargo test', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (e) { console.log('Cargo test skipped'); }"
